paper_title: Computation of Summaries Using Net Unfoldings
statement: We conjecture that the condition e0 e in the definition of cut-off candidate can be replaced by e0 < e, if at the same time the algorithm is required to add events in a suitable order. Similar ideas have proved successful in the past (see e.g. [6, 16]).
context: The algorithm can also be extended to other semantics, including information about failures or completed traces; this material is not contained in the paper because, while laborious, it does not require any new conceptual ideas.
